description: No repository document tells agents whether a direct pytest -n 0 is allowed or whether tests must go through make pr-preflight, or whether several agents may run tests at once. tests/conftest.py (_should_acquire_test_lock) skips ~/.benchbox/test.lock whenever pytest runs with -n 0 or BENCHBOX_SKIP_TEST_LOCK is set, and make pr-preflight itself runs mapped tests with -n 0 'so it never waits on the lock' (docs/internal/dev-loop-worktrees.md, 'Test lock'). In one session several worktrees ran direct pytest -n 0 at the same time while another session held the lock, and the owner had to ask whether the lock was bypassed. The owner's rule is: tests go only through make targets, serially, with no concurrent agents running tests.
